verdict.rationale: Digits is a SaaS accounting platform with web, mobile, API and MCP surfaces, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. The security page's encryption-at-rest, encryption-in-transit and SOC 2 claims are a different privacy control and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
